task_definition.description: PRD docs/prds/freshness-4-variant.md. Implement the complete Failed-state handling per arch §9.1-§9.2 (lines 868-890): (1) catch evaluation failures (panic boundary, kernel error, out-of-bounds, missing-key map lookup) and produce Failed { error: ErrorRef }; emit EventKind::error realization event exactly once per failure; (2) per arch §7.2 line 748 ("Pending as propagation gate") and §9.2 line 890, when a node consumes a Failed input produce Pending { last_substantive } with a diagnostic chain referencing the original failure node — Pending must NOT trigger downstream re-evaluation, naturally quieting the downstream subtree. Constraint violations stay separate (§9.3) — produce cached `violated`, NOT Failed; pin this with a regression test.
